subject: Request: short outcomes snapshot & customer quote for renewal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short outcomes snapshot & customer quote for renewal

Hi Sarah —

Hope you’re well. As we approach Brightleaf’s renewal next month I’m pulling together a short outcomes snapshot and customer quote to include in the renewal packet and a potential one-page case study for our mutual teams. Would Brightleaf be willing to sign off on a 1–2 sentence quote and a 2–3 bullet outcomes summary we can include in the renewal pack?

To make this easy, here’s a suggested format we can tweak:
- One-line quote (1–2 sentences) attribution: Sarah Lee, Head of Platform, Brightleaf Health
- Outcomes bullets (2–3): key metric, before→after, and business impact (e.g., "reduced inference latency 45% leading to 30% drop in user wait-time and 18% lower infra costs")

We can draft everything and send for quick review. If you prefer a short call, Marissa can take a 20 minute interview and transcribe the quote. I attached a draft slide with Brightleaf numbers from Q2 and a one-pager template for the outcomes snapshot.

Low-lift next steps:
1) If you approve, reply with the preferred quote or mark up the bullets in the attached slide.
2) If you’d rather call, reply with a couple time slots and Marissa will coordinate.

Appreciate it — this really helps the renewal narrative and makes the expansion case stronger for your internal stakeholders.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: Brightleaf_Q2_ROI_slide.pdf (pdf, 1 slide)
Attachment: one-pager-redwood-outcomes-template.docx (docx)

-----Original Message-----

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@brightleaf.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: short outcomes snapshot & customer quote for renewal

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the note. We can do this. I skimmed the slide and the numbers look right — Q2 token spend down 18% vs forecast after switching to the cached endpoints, and latency P95 improved from 760ms to 420ms on patient-facing workflows.

I can provide a 1-line quote and bullets. Draft below — feel free to polish for tone.

"Redwood helped Brightleaf reduce inference latency and cost without trade-offs to output quality; the change sped up patient triage flows and lowered hosting spend." — Sarah Lee, Head of Platform, Brightleaf Health

Outcomes (draft):
- Latency (P95) improved 45% on triage flows (760ms → 420ms), improving throughput during peak hours
- Total inference cost vs forecast down 18% for Q2 after KV caching and batching rollout
- Reduced support escalations for slow responses by ~22% month-over-month

We’re happy to be quoted and for you to use these bullets in the renewal packet. Marissa, a short 20 minute call this week would work if you want to capture something more polished.

Cheers,
Sarah

-----Original Message-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short outcomes snapshot & customer quote for renewal

Sarah —

Thanks so much for this — the draft quote and bullets are perfect. If you’re open, I’ll turn your draft into the one-liner and a two-column outcomes slide, then send back for quick sign-off (no edits required). If you’d prefer to record a 10–15 minute call for a direct quote, happy to schedule.

Quick ask from our side: could you also confirm the internal contact we should list for procurement questions during the renewal (name/email)? That ensures the renewal packet has a clear path for the finance team.

I’ll prepare the one-pager and the renewal-facing slide and share the HubSpot link where we keep the draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0678

Thanks Sarah and Tanya — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the stats. 

Action items I’ll take:
- Format Sarah’s one-line quote and the three bullets into the outcomes slide and the one-pager (will drop both into the HubSpot deal record).
- Share the finalized artifacts with you and Tanya for sign-off no later than Friday 2026-08-21.
- Provide a short renewal packet PDF and the DocuSign link once approved.

If anything else is helpful for the internal renewal case (e.g., a short exec note highlighting ROI), let me know and I’ll pull it together.

Thanks again — excited to keep building with Brightleaf.

Best,
